AND character_id = ? LIMIT 1');\n            $charStmt->execute([$campaignId, $characterId]);\n            if (!$charStmt->fetch()) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $invStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT item_id, quantity FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $invStmt->execute([$campaignId, $characterId]);\n            $inventory = [];\n            foreach ($invStmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n                $inventory[$row['item_id']] = (int) $row['quantity'];\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $required) {\n                if (($inventory[$itemId] ?? 0) < $required) {\n                    $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                    return ['error' => 'insufficient ingredients'];\n                }\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $required) {\n                $remaining = $inventory[$itemId] - $required;\n                if ($remaining > 0) {\n                    $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                    $upd->execute([$remaining, $campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n                } else {\n                    $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                    $del->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n                }\n            }\n\n            $addStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, character_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity');\n            $addStmt->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $recipe['output_item'], $recipe['output_quantity']]);\n\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'character_id' => $characterId,\n                'recipe_id' => $recipeId,\n                'output_item' => $recipe['output_item'],\n                'output_quantity' => $recipe['output_quantity'],\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function createPlayCampaignLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId, string $itemId, int $quantity): ?array\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_loot (campaign_id, loot_id, item_id, quantity, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'open')\");\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $lootId, $itemId, $quantity]);\n\n            return [\n                'loot_id' => $lootId,\n                'item_id' => $itemId,\n                'quantity' => $quantity,\n                'status' => 'open',\n            ];\n        } catch (PDOException $e) {\n            if ($e->getCode() === '23000') {\n                return null;\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT loot_id, item_id, quantity, status, recipient_character_id FROM play_campaign_loot WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND recipient_character_id = ?');\n            $tallyStmt->execute([$campaignId, $lootId, $recipientCharacterId]);\n            $count = (int) ($tallyStmt->fetch()['count'] ?? 0);\n\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return ['votes_for_recipient' => $count];\n        } catch (PDOException $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            if ($e->getCode() === '23000') {\n                return null;\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function assignPlayCampaignLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId): ?array\n    {\n        $this->pdo->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');\n        try {\n            $loot = $this->getPlayCampaignLoot($campaignId, $lootId);\n            if ($loot === null || $loot['status'] !== 'open') {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $votes = $this->getPlayCampaignLootVotes($campaignId, $lootId);\n            $tallies = [];\n            foreach ($votes as $vote) {\n                $recipient = $vote['recipient_character_id'];\n                $tallies[$recipient] = ($tallies[$recipient] ?? 0) + 1;\n            }\n            if (count($tallies) === 0) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return ['error' => 'no votes'];\n            }\n            $max = max($tallies);\n            $winners = array_filter($tallies, static fn (int $c): bool => $c === $max);\n            if (count($winners) > 1) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return ['error' => 'vote tie'];\n            }\n            $winner = array_key_first($winners);\n\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare(\"UPDATE play_campaign_loot SET status = 'assigned', recipient_character_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND status = 'open'\");\n            $upd->execute([$winner, $campaignId, $lootId]);\n            if ($upd->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $ins = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, character_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity');\n            $ins->execute([$campaignId, $winner, $loot['item_id'], $loot['quantity']]);\n\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'loot_id' => $lootId,\n                'recipient_character_id' => $winner,\n                'item_id' => $loot['item_id'],\n                'quantity' => $loot['quantity'],\n                'votes' => $max,\n                'status' => 'assigned',\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function createPlayCampaignNpc(string $campaignId, string $npcId, string $name, string $agenda, string $publicStatus): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_npcs (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $npcId, $name, $agenda, $publicStatus]);\n\n            return true;\n        } catch (PDOException $e) {\n            if ($e->getCode() === '23000') {\n                return false;\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignNpc(string $campaignId, string $npcId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT npc_id, name, agenda, public_status FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? LIMIT 1');\n            $charStmt->execute([$campaignId, $characterId]);\n            if (!$charStmt->fetch()) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $invStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT item_id, quantity FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $invStmt->execute([$campaignId, $characterId]);\n            $inventory = [];\n            foreach ($invStmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n                $inventory[$row['item_id']] = (int) $row['quantity'];\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $required) {\n                if (($inventory[$itemId] ?? 0) < $required) {\n                    $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                    return ['error' => 'insufficient ingredients'];\n                }\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $required) {\n                $remaining = $inventory[$itemId] - $required;\n                if ($remaining > 0) {\n                    $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                    $upd->execute([$remaining, $campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n                } else {\n                    $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?');\n                    $del->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $itemId]);\n                }\n            }\n\n            $addStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, character_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity');\n            $addStmt->execute([$campaignId, $characterId, $recipe['output_item'], $recipe['output_quantity']]);\n\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'character_id' => $characterId,\n                'recipe_id' => $recipeId,\n                'output_item' => $recipe['output_item'],\n                'output_quantity' => $recipe['output_quantity'],\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function createPlayCampaignLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId, string $itemId, int $quantity): ?array\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_loot (campaign_id, loot_id, item_id, quantity, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'open')\");\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $lootId, $itemId, $quantity]);\n\n            return [\n                'loot_id' => $lootId,\n                'item_id' => $itemId,\n                'quantity' => $quantity,\n                'status' => 'open',\n            ];\n        } catch (PDOException $e) {\n            if ($e->getCode() === '23000') {\n                return null;\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT loot_id, item_id, quantity, status, recipient_character_id FROM play_campaign_loot WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND recipient_character_id = ?');\n            $tallyStmt->execute([$campaignId, $lootId, $recipientCharacterId]);\n            $count = (int) ($tallyStmt->fetch()['count'] ?? 0);\n\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return ['votes_for_recipient' => $count];\n        } catch (PDOException $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            if ($e->getCode() === '23000') {\n                return null;\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function assignPlayCampaignLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId): ?array\n    {\n        $this->pdo->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');\n        try {\n            $loot = $this->getPlayCampaignLoot($campaignId, $lootId);\n            if ($loot === null || $loot['status'] !== 'open') {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $votes = $this->getPlayCampaignLootVotes($campaignId, $lootId);\n            $tallies = [];\n            foreach ($votes as $vote) {\n                $recipient = $vote['recipient_character_id'];\n                $tallies[$recipient] = ($tallies[$recipient] ?? 0) + 1;\n            }\n            if (count($tallies) === 0) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return ['error' => 'no votes'];\n            }\n            $max = max($tallies);\n            $winners = array_filter($tallies, static fn (int $c): bool => $c === $max);\n            if (count($winners) > 1) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return ['error' => 'vote tie'];\n            }\n            $winner = array_key_first($winners);\n\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare(\"UPDATE play_campaign_loot SET status = 'assigned', recipient_character_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND status = 'open'\");\n            $upd->execute([$winner, $campaignId, $lootId]);\n            if ($upd->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $ins = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, character_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity');\n            $ins->execute([$campaignId, $winner, $loot['item_id'], $loot['quantity']]);\n\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'loot_id' => $lootId,\n                'recipient_character_id' => $winner,\n                'item_id' => $loot['item_id'],\n                'quantity' => $loot['quantity'],\n                'votes' => $max,\n                'status' => 'assigned',\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function createPlayCampaignNpc(string $campaignId, string $npcId, string $name, string $agenda, string $publicStatus): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO play_campaign_npcs (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $npcId, $name, $agenda, $publicStatus]);\n\n            return true;\n        } catch (PDOException $e) {\n            if ($e->getCode() === '23000') {\n                return false;\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignNpc(string $campaignId, string $npcId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT npc_id, name, agenda, public_status FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? For updates the returned settlementId\n     * is empty and should be taken from the path.\n     */\n    private function validateSettlementPayload(?array $body, bool $requireId): array|JsonResponse\n    {\n        if (!is_array($body)) {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid json');\n        }\n\n        if ($requireId) {\n            if (!isset($body['settlement_id']) || !is_string($body['settlement_id']) || $body['settlement_id'] === '') {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid settlement_id');\n            }\n            $settlementId = $body['settlement_id'];\n        } else {\n            $settlementId = '';\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['name']) || !is_string($body['name']) || $body['name'] === '') {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid name');\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['services']) || !is_array($body['services']) || count($body['services']) === 0) {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n        }\n        $services = [];\n        $seen = [];\n        foreach ($body['services'] as $service) {\n            if (!is_string($service)) {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n            }\n            $normalized = trim($service);\n            if ($normalized === '') {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n            }\n            if (isset($seen[$normalized])) {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n            }\n            $seen[$normalized] = true;\n            $services[] = $normalized;\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['availability']) || !is_string($body['availability']) || !in_array($body['availability'], ['open', 'limited', 'closed'], true)) {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid availability');\n        }\n\n        return [$settlementId, $body['name'], $services, $body['availability']];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Validate a shop || !is_string($body['shop_id']) || $body['shop_id'] === '') {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid shop_id');\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['name']) || !is_string($body['name']) ||    return HttpHelper::error('invalid stock');\n        }\n        $stock = [];\n        foreach ($body['stock'] as $itemId => $qty) {\n            if (!is_string($itemId) || $itemId === '' || !in_array($itemId, self::PLAY_CAMPAIGN_INVENTORY_ITEMS, true)) {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid stock');\n            }\n            if (!is_int($qty) || $qty <= 0) {\n   {\n        if (!is_array($body)) {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid json');\n        }\n\n        if ($requireId) {\n            if (!isset($body['settlement_id']) || !is_string($body['settlement_id']) || $body['settlement_id'] === '') {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid settlement_id');\n            }\n            $settlementId = $body['settlement_id'];\n        } else {\n            $settlementId = '';\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['name']) || !is_string($body['name']) || $body['name'] === '') {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid name');\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['services']) || !is_array($body['services']) || count($body['services']) === 0) {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n        }\n        $services = [];\n        $seen = [];\n        foreach ($body['services'] as $service) {\n            if (!is_string($service)) {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n            }\n            $normalized = trim($service);\n            if ($normalized === '') {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n            }\n            if (isset($seen[$normalized])) {\n                return HttpHelper::error('invalid services');\n            }\n            $seen[$normalized] = true;\n            $services[] = $normalized;\n        }\n\n        if (!isset($body['availability']) || !is_string($body['availability']) || !in_array($body['availability'], ['open', 'limited', 'closed'], true)) {\n            return HttpHelper::error('invalid availability');\n        }\n\n        return [$settlementId, $body['name'], $services, $body['availability']];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Validate a shop
